thread:
Ava: Heads up, noticed sampleapp UI hitching when token refresh happens after a 401 on Android 14 emulator.
Marcus: Any stack or code?
Ava: Found it: TokenAuthenticator invokes runBlocking which ends up executing on Main in our test harness.
Priya: runBlocking in network hooks is risky. Our Kotlin samples encourage suspend usage but don't warn about dispatchers.
Marcus: Could be our token repo using withContext(Main) somewhere.
Ava: Repro: enable slow network, expire token, hit protected endpoint, observe ~800ms stall and 'Main dispatcher missing' in logs.
BuildBot: CI test flaky: https://ci/internal/issue/7892
Priya: Proposal: update sampleapp to use sync token cache + background refresh or single-flight refresh on IO. Also add doc line: "do not block on Main in interceptors/authenticators."
Marcus: I'll draft PR with the fix and a unit that simulates Authenticator flow.
Ava: Thanks, will attach a tiny repro gist. :thumbsup:
